thread:
Nora (Finance): FYI: SageBridge (EU reseller) asked for one-off pilot pricing: 18% usage credit + Net60 for 5 months. They want VAT passthrough. Need deal desk + legal OK.

Evan (Sales): Short context: pilot to win two hospital pilots in ITA/ESP, projected 90k tokens/mo rising to 300k. They asked for 'introductory support' to offset onboarding costs.

Sam (RevOps): Ops constraints: cap total credits at EUR15k, restrict to reseller account mapping, require clawback if end-customer cancels within 75 days. Also need Zuora config for a custom pilot-credit line.

Rita (Legal): I can draft a slim addendum. Need clear definition of "usage credit", expiration, clawback mechanism, and VAT representation from reseller.

Nora (Finance): Net60 is outside default. CFO needs to sign off on extended terms. Also confirm how we book the credits for revenue recognition.

CFO-bot: Alert: Net60 will increase DSO. Recommend 50% holdback of credits until month 3 and require reseller credit check.

Sam (RevOps): Noted. I'll open ticket ZOA-8123 for Zuora rules and ask billing to implement 50% holdback and pilot credit GL mapping.

Evan (Sales): I'll get VAT ID and trade refs from SageBridge and route addendum for signature once Rita sends it. ETA 48h.

Rita (Legal): Draft sent to Evan. Once signed, Nora please confirm accounting treatment and Sam confirms ZOA-8123 is done.

Nora (Finance): Approve in principle pending signed addendum and Zuora config. Final approval after both items are complete.

Evan (Sales): Thanks all, I'll update thread when signed. :thumbsup:
